costumes.name: Young Ishtar survivor
wardrobe: Plain, worn brown leather separates; simple practical leather boots and belt.
continuityNotes: Hunting knife carried at the belt.

costumes.name: Cloaked departure
wardrobe: Same leather base with a plain weathered cloak; no ornate armour.

costumes.name: Quest hunter
wardrobe: Heavy hooded cloak, practical backpack, repaired leather layers, plain protective pieces and tool belts.
Dirt, fatigue and abrasion increase through the quest.
continuityNotes: The hood hides her age until the recognition in the lair.

costumes.name: Fifteen-year reveal
wardrobe: Threadbare, damaged leather layers with the hood down; soot on the skin and clothes.
continuityNotes: Burnt left forearm visible; healed and fresh injuries shown without gore.

costumes.name: Aftermath
wardrobe: Threadbare base clothes only; armour, backpack and tool belts left behind.
